source_name: Koomen et al. (1952) Fig. 3 plus Table I, Sacramento Peak
description: Solar-meridian twilight brightness and polarization reference for H=-6 deg at Sacramento Peak. Intensity values come from Table I (Z=0); polarization factors are digitized from Fig. 3 and converted to DoLP.
notes: This is a meridian-only polarization validation subset, not a full-sky measurement field.
The DoLP values are approximate because the publication provides the H=-6 polarization data as a plotted curve, not a table.
